title: Three-dimensional liquid metal-based neuro-interfaces for human hippocampal organoids
abstract: It was a very honourable experience to follow a freshly published paper to learn the experimental skills and start my research journey. During the process, the principle and procedure of fabricating metal polymer conductors utilizing micro-nano fabrication based on PDMS were mastered. In addition, numerous skills pertinent to research were acquired, all thanks to Postdoc Wu Yan.

title: Organoid vascularization through perfusion vessel model utilizing mesh-MPC
abstract: The objective of this project is to simulate the implementation of a clinical ECG monitor. To this end, the project will acquire, process, and analyze ECG signals using a MATLAB-based data acquisition system and a Django web interface.
